task.title: Define conversation pipeline in daemon
task.subtask: Add conversation pipeline type to the daemon's pipeline registry (alongside story, epic)
Define the pipeline agent: ASSISTANT with name "Project Assistant", model opus, allowed tools Read,Grep,Glob,Bash
Define the pipeline step sequence: gather-context, graph-search, respond, compile-conversation (conditional), sync
Configure variable capture: step outputs stored as PROJECT_CONTEXT, GRAPH_RESULTS for prompt interpolation

task.title: Implement Step 1 — gather-context shell step
task.subtask: Create shell command that reads knowledge/index.md and knowledge/system/pending-work.md from the project working directory
Append a file tree via find . -type f ... | head -200
Capture combined output as PROJECT_CONTEXT variable
Handle missing files gracefully (pending-work.md may not exist yet)

task.title: Implement Step 2 — graph-search shell step
task.subtask: Create shell command: node /home/ubuntu/scripts/graph-search.mjs --project {{projectId}} --query "{{USER_QUERY}}" --top-k 15 --hops 3
Capture output as GRAPH_RESULTS variable
Handle empty results (no nodes in Memgraph yet) — pipeline should still proceed

task.title: Implement Step 3 — conversational agent step
task.subtask: Create the agent prompt template with {{PROJECT_CONTEXT}}, {{GRAPH_RESULTS}}, and {{USER_QUERY}} interpolation points
Include instructions for the agent to reference wiki articles by [[wikilink]] notation
Include instructions for ---NEW_KNOWLEDGE--- block extraction when conversations produce new insights
Configure agent with allowedTools: Read,Grep,Glob,Bash for live code exploration
Set agent model to opus for complex multi-step reasoning

task.title: Define the NEW_KNOWLEDGE extraction format
task.subtask: Document the structured block format: ---NEW_KNOWLEDGE--- / ---END_NEW_KNOWLEDGE--- with type, title, content, links fields
Create a parser that extracts NEW_KNOWLEDGE blocks from agent output
Store extracted knowledge items for the conditional compilation step (Story 5.4)

task.title: Pipeline integration test
task.subtask: Register the conversation pipeline in the daemon and verify it appears in the pipeline list
Trigger a test conversation pipeline for a project with populated Memgraph
Verify Step 1 captures project context correctly
Verify Step 2 returns GraphRAG results for the query
Verify Step 3 agent responds with contextual awareness

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A new conversation pipeline type is defined in the daemon pipeline system alongside existing story and epic pipelines
Step 1 (gather-context): a shell step gathers project context — reads index.md, pending-work.md, and generates a file tree (capped at 200 entries)
Step 2 (graph-search): a shell step calls graph-search.mjs with the user's query, --top-k 15, and --hops 3 to get GraphRAG results
Step 3 (respond): a conversational agent (Opus model) responds with full project context + graph search results, with access to Read, Grep, Glob, Bash tools for live code exploration
The agent references wiki articles and decisions by their [[wikilinks]]
If the conversation produces new knowledge, it is captured in a ---NEW_KNOWLEDGE--- / ---END_NEW_KNOWLEDGE--- structured block with type, title, content, and links fields
The pipeline captures step outputs as named variables (PROJECT_CONTEXT, GRAPH_RESULTS, USER_QUERY) for prompt interpolation

constraints.constraint: The conversation pipeline is stateless per run — all context comes from knowledge graph and live tools, not conversation memory. The knowledge graph IS the memory.
Pipeline definition must conform to the PipelineDefinition interface in functions/shared/types/agent-orchestrator.ts
Agent step uses model 'opus' for complex multi-step reasoning about the codebase
Agent has access to Read,Grep,Glob,Bash tools for live code exploration during conversations
Shell step outputs must be captured via captureAs and interpolated into agent prompts via {{VAR}} template substitution
Pipeline must proceed even if graph-search returns empty results (new project with no Memgraph data yet)

interface.description: Conversation pipeline registered in daemon pipeline system
interface.steps: gather-context (shell) -> graph-search (shell) -> respond (agent) -> compile-conversation (agent, conditional) -> sync (shell)

interface.description: Structured block format for capturing insights from conversations
interface.format:
---NEW_KNOWLEDGE---
- type: decision | insight | requirement | risk
 title: ...
 content: ...
 links: [related wiki articles]
---END_NEW_KNOWLEDGE---
